title: Gunslugs
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#856, 2026-11-01), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 2 of 5: it reaches the title screen and closes as soon as A is pressed to play, and its log ends with 'Failed loading libusb-1.0.dll: Module not found', the GOG copy. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#856 (2026-11-03): with no gamepad connected the game gets in game. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#856 (2026-11-04): with libusb-1.0.dll from libusb 1.0.30's MinGW64 build placed next to gunslugs.exe, the game plays with the DualSense.
notes: Plays in one report on an M1 with D3DMetal. With a controller it needs libusb-1.0.dll next to the game's exe, see the known issue.

knownIssues.symptom: With a controller connected, closes as soon as A is pressed at the title screen to play (M1, DualSense, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r28)
knownIssues.cause: when the game finds a controller it loads a native library of its own that needs libusb-1.0.dll, which isn't part of Windows, Wine or the game's files, so the load fails ('Failed loading libusb-1.0.dll: Module not found') and the game exits
knownIssues.fix: put libusb-1.0.dll next to gunslugs.exe, from the MinGW64/dll folder of libusb's Windows release (1.0.30, github.com/libusb/libusb/releases), which made the DualSense work for the reporter (highball-db#856). Without it, start with the controller unplugged and play with the keyboard
